# Irina Marinescu — fliwheel.xyz

## Who I am

Irina Marinescu is a lawyer, founder, and operator with over a decade at the frontier of emerging technology. She is a Partner at DLx Law PLLC (New York and Illinois bars), a boutique practice focused on digital assets, AI, and infrastructure law. She previously served as General Counsel at Gitcoin (Paradigm-backed), where she built DAO governance frameworks that became industry standard for open source crypto protocols. She co-founded and served as CEO of buidlbox, a developer platform for web3 builders that was acquired by HackQuest. Earlier in her career she spent nearly a decade in BigLaw (Paul Hastings, Katten, Haynes Boone) on $7B+ in structured finance transactions, with preceding roles at the SEC, World Bank, federal court, and Barclays Capital during the global financial crisis.

## What I do

Irina advises founders, operators, and investors building at the intersection of crypto, AI, and infrastructure — where regulation hasn't caught up to the technology yet. Her work spans:

- Digital asset regulation: token structuring, GENIUS Act, SEC/CFTC classification, stablecoin frameworks, commercial law
- AI governance and agentic systems: liability frameworks, world model risk, regulatory strategy for AI-native ventures
- Data center and HPC infrastructure: FERC co-location, power agreements, miner-to-HPC transitions, project finance
- DAO and protocol governance: entity structuring, token governance frameworks
- Venture and capital markets: institutional strategy, deal structuring, diligence
